trueIncompatibilities.detail: validateStage1() demands LR01 schema/revision/packageId/stage and a fixed SHA-256 of the WHOLE package JSON. An LR02 patch or v2 package cannot pass it; a separately reviewed Gameplay pin is required.

trueIncompatibilities.detail: projectVeyra() returns statics: [] and derives POI containment only from canonical foot polygons. It never reads LR01 geometryAdapters.collision.staticWalls, so physical POI walls/doorways do not exist in the runtime World.
